# SovRing-Labs

> SovRing-Labs is one person's open research lab building AI that runs on the computers people already own.

Start: read README.md (60 seconds), then QUICKSTART.md (5 minutes: paste-to-assistant or 3 commands). `install.sh` clones the repos you choose and runs each quick test; `.mcp/server.py` is a stdio MCP server (Python, no dependencies) with tools explain, check_readiness, setup_steps, fetch_repo, quick_test, list_tests, run_test, get_evidence. Status: pre-alpha, under development — STATUS.md says what works today. Re-check every claim with one file: the release asset sovring-suite.pyz (https://github.com/SovRing-Labs/SovRing/releases/latest/download/sovring-suite.pyz; `python3 sovring-suite.pyz --run <repo>`).

## Umbrella
- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/SovRing/main/README.md)
- [QUICKSTART.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/SovRing/main/QUICKSTART.md)
- [repos.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/SovRing/main/repos.json): machine-readable registry (setup, quick test, needs, licence, DOI)
- [STATUS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/SovRing/main/STATUS.md)

## Engines
- [armilla-astrolabe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/armilla-astrolabe/main/AGENTS.md): Carry-free residue-number-system engine on ordinary CPUs: exact integer arithmetic on coprime prime rings, with a ternary pull engine, an exact training step and RNS modular exponentiation. Quick test: `PYTHONPATH=engine python3 -m pytest -q engine/tests`. Docs: [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/armilla-astrolabe/main/README.md), [TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/armilla-astrolabe/main/TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md), [PROVENANCE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/armilla-astrolabe/main/PROVENANCE.md), [LICENSING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/armilla-astrolabe/main/LICENSING.md), [CITATION.cff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/armilla-astrolabe/main/CITATION.cff), [STATUS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/armilla-astrolabe/main/STATUS.md), [suite.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/armilla-astrolabe/main/suite.json)
- [omni-ring](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-ring/main/AGENTS.md): Residue hyperdimensional computing engine: coprime-ring (CRT) memory with a check ring, resonator decode, two-faced ternary/phase hypervector slot, AVX2 C kernel, shards and a shared-memory bus. Quick test: `./build_kernel.sh && python3 -m pytest -q`. Docs: [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-ring/main/README.md), [DOSSIER.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-ring/main/DOSSIER.md), [TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-ring/main/TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md), [PROVENANCE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-ring/main/PROVENANCE.md), [LICENSING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-ring/main/LICENSING.md), [CITATION.cff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-ring/main/CITATION.cff), [STATUS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-ring/main/STATUS.md), [suite.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-ring/main/suite.json)
- [vsa-core](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/vsa-core/main/AGENTS.md): Ternary vector-symbolic kernel (10,240-dim, two bitplanes) and a POSIX shared-memory blackboard with a seqlock, AVX2 SIMD, phase kernel and trust classifier; C/C++ with a Python client. Quick test: `make -s && python3 xlang_test.py`. Docs: [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/vsa-core/main/README.md), [DOSSIER.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/vsa-core/main/DOSSIER.md), [TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/vsa-core/main/TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md), [PROVENANCE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/vsa-core/main/PROVENANCE.md), [LICENSING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/vsa-core/main/LICENSING.md), [CITATION.cff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/vsa-core/main/CITATION.cff), [STATUS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/vsa-core/main/STATUS.md), [suite.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/vsa-core/main/suite.json)

## Agent tooling
- [tarsus](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/tarsus/main/AGENTS.md): Safe hands for tool-calling agents: batch tool execution with payload repair, a deterministic safety guard, kernel (Landlock) write confinement, human-only approval, audit trail and an MCP server. Linux only. Quick test: `python3 bin/omnitool_guard.py selftest`. Docs: [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/tarsus/main/README.md), [DOSSIER.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/tarsus/main/DOSSIER.md), [TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/tarsus/main/TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md), [PROVENANCE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/tarsus/main/PROVENANCE.md), [LICENSING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/tarsus/main/LICENSING.md), [CITATION.cff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/tarsus/main/CITATION.cff), [STATUS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/tarsus/main/STATUS.md), [suite.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/tarsus/main/suite.json)
- [talon](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/talon/main/AGENTS.md): Standalone agent runtime and role-shell terminal: talon run/serve, multi-provider lanes, tool loop, session store. Quick test: `make test`. Docs: [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/talon/main/README.md), [DOSSIER.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/talon/main/DOSSIER.md), [TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/talon/main/TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md), [PROVENANCE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/talon/main/PROVENANCE.md), [LICENSING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/talon/main/LICENSING.md), [CITATION.cff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/talon/main/CITATION.cff), [STATUS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/talon/main/STATUS.md), [suite.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/talon/main/suite.json)
- [agent-reliability-kit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/agent-reliability-kit/main/AGENTS.md): Deterministic dispatch routing, a Rust done-gate that demands physical proof of completion, and research grounding for agent briefs. Quick test: `PYTHONPATH=.:bin python3 -m pytest -q tests/`. Docs: [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/agent-reliability-kit/main/README.md), [DOSSIER.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/agent-reliability-kit/main/DOSSIER.md), [TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/agent-reliability-kit/main/TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md), [PROVENANCE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/agent-reliability-kit/main/PROVENANCE.md), [LICENSING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/agent-reliability-kit/main/LICENSING.md), [CITATION.cff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/agent-reliability-kit/main/CITATION.cff), [STATUS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/agent-reliability-kit/main/STATUS.md), [suite.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/agent-reliability-kit/main/suite.json)
- [cost-savers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/cost-savers/main/AGENTS.md): Six OpenCode plugins and four CLI tools that cut what coding agents send to paid models, with a pre-registered paired A/B. Quick test: `make test`. Docs: [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/cost-savers/main/README.md), [DOSSIER.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/cost-savers/main/DOSSIER.md), [TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/cost-savers/main/TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md), [PROVENANCE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/cost-savers/main/PROVENANCE.md), [LICENSING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/cost-savers/main/LICENSING.md), [CITATION.cff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/cost-savers/main/CITATION.cff), [STATUS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/cost-savers/main/STATUS.md), [suite.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/cost-savers/main/suite.json)
- [dock](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/dock/main/AGENTS.md): One MCP server for any number of MCP servers: clients see two tools (search_tools, call_tool) at a constant token cost, and tool search abstains when nothing is relevant. Zero dependencies. Quick test: `npm test`. Docs: [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/dock/main/README.md), [DOSSIER.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/dock/main/DOSSIER.md), [TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/dock/main/TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md), [PROVENANCE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/dock/main/PROVENANCE.md), [LICENSING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/dock/main/LICENSING.md), [CITATION.cff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/dock/main/CITATION.cff), [STATUS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/dock/main/STATUS.md), [suite.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/dock/main/suite.json)
- [omnid](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omnid/main/AGENTS.md): One small C++ server for local embeddings (nomic-embed-text v1.5 and BitNet-embedding-270M on llama.cpp), a hardened local web face and an MCP face. Models and the bitnet.cpp tree are not shipped. Quick test: `BITNET_DIR=~/projects/bitnet ./build.sh && python3 -m pytest -q tests`. Docs: [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omnid/main/README.md), [DOSSIER.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omnid/main/DOSSIER.md), [TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omnid/main/TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md), [PROVENANCE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omnid/main/PROVENANCE.md), [CITATION.cff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omnid/main/CITATION.cff), [STATUS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omnid/main/STATUS.md), [suite.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omnid/main/suite.json)

## Browser
- [omni-render](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-render/main/AGENTS.md): Our own web rendering engine in Rust: packed DOM, own CSS engine, integer layout, 2-bit raster, a program runtime that emits x86, a JavaScript interpreter on its own IR, and a self-repair core for layout. Quick test: `cargo test --release`. Docs: [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-render/main/README.md), [DOSSIER.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-render/main/DOSSIER.md), [TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-render/main/TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md), [PROVENANCE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-render/main/PROVENANCE.md), [LICENSING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-render/main/LICENSING.md), [CITATION.cff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-render/main/CITATION.cff), [STATUS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-render/main/STATUS.md), [suite.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-render/main/suite.json)
- [omni-ui](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-ui/main/AGENTS.md): Native apps and a light-use web browser (Omni Web) drawn by the omni-render engine: one packed widget tree is both drawn and read by assistive technology, and a broker plus one confined process per page. Quick test: `cargo build --release && python3 tests/verify_calendar.py`. Docs: [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-ui/main/README.md), [DOSSIER.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-ui/main/DOSSIER.md), [TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-ui/main/TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md), [PROVENANCE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-ui/main/PROVENANCE.md), [LICENSING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-ui/main/LICENSING.md), [CITATION.cff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-ui/main/CITATION.cff), [STATUS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-ui/main/STATUS.md), [suite.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-ui/main/suite.json)

## Research
- [omniring-research](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omniring-research/main/AGENTS.md): Public research corpus of the OMNIRING project: numbered disclosure chapters, pre-registered ring-resonator experiments (PASS and KILL both published) with their numpy harnesses and run logs, and a status disclosure that marks each later result Measured or NOT YET TESTED. Quick test: `python3 harness/ring1/run_halo.py --quick`. Docs: [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omniring-research/main/README.md), [CITATION.cff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omniring-research/main/CITATION.cff), [STATUS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omniring-research/main/STATUS.md), [suite.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omniring-research/main/suite.json)

## Cores umbrella
- [cores](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/cores/main/AGENTS.md): The SovRing cores umbrella: Cores Studio (an offline local studio that routes prompts to spreadsheet, graphics, slide, voice and diagram cores, ingests files, searches your shard lake, runs a clean-room pipeline and bundles the results) with the doctor, math, embed, guard, redteam and core-models cores pinned as submodules. Quick test: `bash tests/run-all.sh`. Docs: [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/cores/main/README.md), [TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/cores/main/TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md), [PROVENANCE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/cores/main/PROVENANCE.md), [LICENSING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/cores/main/LICENSING.md), [CITATION.cff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/cores/main/CITATION.cff), [STATUS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/cores/main/STATUS.md), [suite.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/cores/main/suite.json)

## Core modules
- [doctor-core](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/doctor-core/main/AGENTS.md): The doctor method: a core that finds what is wrong in code and in page geometry, finds donor code and exact fixes, tests them with an exact judge and learns which fix to try first - with its web HTML/JS suite (torus layers, T25 core), ternary fix ranker, clean-room pipeline notes and Common Crawl harness. Quick test: `python3 tests/check.py live && node web/tests/torus-pairs.mjs web/samples`. Docs: [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/doctor-core/main/README.md), [TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/doctor-core/main/TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md), [PROVENANCE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/doctor-core/main/PROVENANCE.md), [LICENSING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/doctor-core/main/LICENSING.md), [CITATION.cff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/doctor-core/main/CITATION.cff), [STATUS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/doctor-core/main/STATUS.md), [suite.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/doctor-core/main/suite.json)
- [math-core](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/math-core/main/AGENTS.md): The math core: a factory that turns a published definition into a verified concept (reference definition, recorded rows, property laws with teeth, generators, composer). Quick test: `python3 -I tools/defcheck.py . | tail -1`. Docs: [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/math-core/main/README.md), [TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/math-core/main/TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md), [PROVENANCE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/math-core/main/PROVENANCE.md), [LICENSING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/math-core/main/LICENSING.md), [CITATION.cff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/math-core/main/CITATION.cff), [STATUS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/math-core/main/STATUS.md), [suite.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/math-core/main/suite.json)
- [embed-core](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/embed-core/main/AGENTS.md): Static token-table embedding, ternary readouts and curriculum regression gates. Quick test: `python3 -B checks/curriculum.py`. Docs: [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/embed-core/main/README.md), [TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/embed-core/main/TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md), [PROVENANCE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/embed-core/main/PROVENANCE.md), [LICENSING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/embed-core/main/LICENSING.md), [CITATION.cff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/embed-core/main/CITATION.cff), [STATUS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/embed-core/main/STATUS.md), [suite.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/embed-core/main/suite.json)
- [guard-core](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/guard-core/main/AGENTS.md): Receipt-reconciled file-integrity baseline for your own files. Quick test: `python3 tests/guard_demo.py`. Docs: [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/guard-core/main/README.md), [TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/guard-core/main/TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md), [PROVENANCE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/guard-core/main/PROVENANCE.md), [LICENSING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/guard-core/main/LICENSING.md), [CITATION.cff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/guard-core/main/CITATION.cff), [STATUS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/guard-core/main/STATUS.md), [suite.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/guard-core/main/suite.json)
- [redteam-core](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/redteam-core/main/AGENTS.md): Own-system surface census and experimental defensive testing CLI. Quick test: `python3 tests/local_demo.py`. Docs: [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/redteam-core/main/README.md), [TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/redteam-core/main/TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md), [PROVENANCE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/redteam-core/main/PROVENANCE.md), [LICENSING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/redteam-core/main/LICENSING.md), [CITATION.cff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/redteam-core/main/CITATION.cff), [STATUS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/redteam-core/main/STATUS.md), [suite.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/redteam-core/main/suite.json)
- [core-models](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/core-models/main/AGENTS.md): Fixed ternary reservoirs, ridge readouts, associative rule memory and local splining experiments. Quick test: `OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 python3 -B checks/probes.py`. Docs: [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/core-models/main/README.md), [TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/core-models/main/TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md), [PROVENANCE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/core-models/main/PROVENANCE.md), [LICENSING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/core-models/main/LICENSING.md), [CITATION.cff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/core-models/main/CITATION.cff), [STATUS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/core-models/main/STATUS.md), [suite.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/core-models/main/suite.json)
- [armilla-defense](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/armilla-defense/main/AGENTS.md): Signed input lanes, watch-only socket gates and redundant-residue fault sensing. Quick test: `python3 tests/local_demo.py lanes`. Docs: [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/armilla-defense/main/README.md), [TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/armilla-defense/main/TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md), [PROVENANCE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/armilla-defense/main/PROVENANCE.md), [LICENSING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/armilla-defense/main/LICENSING.md), [CITATION.cff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/armilla-defense/main/CITATION.cff), [STATUS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/armilla-defense/main/STATUS.md), [suite.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/armilla-defense/main/suite.json)

## Armilla variants
- [armilla-crypto](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/armilla-crypto/main/AGENTS.md): RNS Montgomery cryptography workloads Quick test: `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 tests/check.py native`. Docs: [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/armilla-crypto/main/README.md), [TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/armilla-crypto/main/TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md), [PROVENANCE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/armilla-crypto/main/PROVENANCE.md), [LICENSING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/armilla-crypto/main/LICENSING.md), [CITATION.cff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/armilla-crypto/main/CITATION.cff), [STATUS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/armilla-crypto/main/STATUS.md), [suite.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/armilla-crypto/main/suite.json)
- [armilla-decoder](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/armilla-decoder/main/AGENTS.md): Exact decoder mathematics on residue rings Quick test: `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 tests/check.py h264`. Docs: [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/armilla-decoder/main/README.md), [TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/armilla-decoder/main/TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md), [PROVENANCE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/armilla-decoder/main/PROVENANCE.md), [LICENSING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/armilla-decoder/main/LICENSING.md), [CITATION.cff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/armilla-decoder/main/CITATION.cff), [STATUS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/armilla-decoder/main/STATUS.md), [suite.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/armilla-decoder/main/suite.json)
- [liquid-armilla](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/liquid-armilla/main/AGENTS.md): A liquid ternary reservoir (N=1024, K=16, ternary recurrent weights, trained ridge readout) in plain-integer form and in ring-state form: state as residues on 15 rings with a 2-of-3 vote per tick, readout plate as 12-bit integers on 12 rings; compiled AVX2 kernel, exactness, fault and identity harnesses, and the negative results. Quick test: `T=$(mktemp -d) && cp liq-armilla/fault_kernel_test.py liq-armilla/ring_kernel.py liq-armilla/ring_kernel.c $T/ && (cd $T && python3 fault_kernel_test.py | tail -3)`. Docs: [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/liquid-armilla/main/README.md), [TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/liquid-armilla/main/TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md), [PROVENANCE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/liquid-armilla/main/PROVENANCE.md), [LICENSING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/liquid-armilla/main/LICENSING.md), [CITATION.cff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/liquid-armilla/main/CITATION.cff), [STATUS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/liquid-armilla/main/STATUS.md), [suite.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/liquid-armilla/main/suite.json)

## Libraries
- [omni-spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-spec/main/AGENTS.md): 25 standards implemented from the specification text only (Unicode line breaking, graphemes and bidi; JSON; XML; HTML tokenizer; DEFLATE; Brotli; ZIP; PNG; GIF; JPEG; WebP; OpenType; WOFF2; Office Open XML; WebM; parts of Opus) in dependency-free Rust. Quick test: `cargo test --offline --test json --test sha256`. Docs: [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-spec/main/README.md), [TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-spec/main/TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md), [PROVENANCE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-spec/main/PROVENANCE.md), [LICENSING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-spec/main/LICENSING.md), [CITATION.cff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-spec/main/CITATION.cff), [STATUS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-spec/main/STATUS.md), [suite.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-spec/main/suite.json)
- [omni-equations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-equations/main/AGENTS.md): Our equation library: 67 concepts as dependency-free Rust, with their definitions, laws and recorded spec rows; free for the community. Quick test: `python3 -I tools/verify.py . --only hamming,fib,gcd,mod_inverse,ntt | tail -1`. Docs: [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-equations/main/README.md), [TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-equations/main/TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md), [PROVENANCE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-equations/main/PROVENANCE.md), [LICENSING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-equations/main/LICENSING.md), [CITATION.cff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-equations/main/CITATION.cff), [STATUS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-equations/main/STATUS.md), [suite.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-equations/main/suite.json)
- [trit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/trit/main/AGENTS.md): Packed ternary weights (P2 4 trits/byte, P3 1.6 bits/weight, L5 compute on storage) with integer-only kernels that are bit-identical on scalar, AVX2, AVX-512 and NEON, in C++ and Rust. Quick test: `g++ -O3 -march=native -fopenmp -std=c++17 -Icpp tests/trit_kernel_test.cpp -o /tmp/trit_kernel_test && /tmp/trit_kernel_test | tail -1`. Docs: [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/trit/main/README.md), [TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/trit/main/TECHNICAL-DISCLOSURE.md), [PROVENANCE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/trit/main/PROVENANCE.md), [LICENSING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/trit/main/LICENSING.md), [CITATION.cff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/trit/main/CITATION.cff), [STATUS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/trit/main/STATUS.md), [suite.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SovRing-Labs/trit/main/suite.json)
